entries.def:
Ἀσάφ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָסַף), [H609]
Asaph, an obvious error for Ἀσά, found in the best texts, and adopted by LTTr. and WH, R, mg.: Mat.1.7-8.†
(AS)

ἀ-σάλευτος, -ον
(σαλεύω), [in LXX: Exo.13.16, Deu.6.8; 11.18 (טוֹפָפָה)* ;] 
unmoved, immovable: Act.27.41 metaphorically, Heb.12.28.†
(AS)

ἄ-σβεστος, -ον
(σβέννυμι), [in LXX for נָפַח לֹא, Job.20.26 א3 A (ἄκαυστον, א2 B)* ;] 
unquenched, unquenchable: πῦρ, Mat.3.12, Mrk.9.43, Luk.3.17.†
(AS)

ἀσέβεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀσεβής), [in LXX for פֶּשַׁע, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;] 
ungodliness, impiety: Rom.1.18; 11.26, 2Ti.2.16, Tit.2.12; ἔργα ἀσεβείας, ungodly deeds, Jude.15; ἐπιθυηίαι τ. ἀσεβειῶν, desires for ungodly things or deeds, Jude.18 (DB, iv, 532; Cremer, 523; MM, see word).†
(AS)

ἀσεβέω, -ῶ
(ἀσεβής), [in LXX for פָּשַׁע, רָשַׁע ;] 
to be ungodly, act profanely: 2Pe.2.6 with cogn. accusative (MM, see word), Jude.15.†
(AS)

ἀσεβής, -ές
(σέβω, to reverence), [in LXX chiefly for רָשַׁע ;] 
un­godly, impious: Rom.4.5; 5.6, 1Ti.1.9, 1Pe.4.18, 2Pe.2.5-6; 3.7, Jude.4,15.†
(AS)

ἀσέλγεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀσελγής, licentious; see MM, see word), [in LXX: Wis.14.26, 3Ma.2.26 * ;] 
licentiousness, wantonness, excess: Mrk.7.22, Rom.13.13, 2Co.12.21, Gal.5.19 (Lft., in l), Eph.4.19, 1Pe.4.3, 2Pe.2.2; 2.7; 2.18, Jude.4.†
SYN.: ἀσωτία, profligacy, prodigality (see Tr., Syn., § xvi; DB, iii, 46). (AS)

ἄσημος, -ον
(σῆμα, a mark), [in LXX: Gen.30.42 (עָטַף), Job.42.11, 3Ma.1.3 * ;] 
without mark (in π. of an uncircumcised boy: Deiss., BS, 153; MM, see word). Metaphorical (MM, see word), unknown, obscure: litotes, οὐκ ἄ (Eur., al.), πόλις, Act.21.39.†
(AS)

Ἀσήρ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָשֵׁר), 
Asher: Luk.2.36, Rev.7.6.†
(AS)

ἀσθένεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀσθενής), [in LXX for כָּשַׁל, etc. ;] 
weakness, frailty, sickness: Luk.13.11-12, Jhn.11.4, Act.28.9, Rom.6.19; 8.26, 2Co.11.30; 13.4, Gal.4.13 (MM, see word), Heb.5.2; 7.28; 11.34; ἐν ἀ., Jhn.5.5, 1Co.2.3; 15.43, 2Co.12.9; pl., Mat.8.17, Luk.5.15; 8.2, 2Co.12.5; 12.9-10, 1Ti.5.23, Heb.4.15.†
SYN.: μαλακία, νόσος (see DB, iii, 323a) (AS)
